pages.text: These artifacts are in the Tefnut Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Tefnut to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
Draw this bow fully to split the arrow into a shower of smaller arrows. Use it with room for the spread.
A spear for melee and throwing. Hold Use for a little over a second, then release. In survival the thrown spear leaves your hand, so retrieve it after the attack.
